heading: Service of process
lead: The corporation shall comply with the law on service of process of each State in which it is incorporated and each State in which it carries on activities.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 7011036:5604.Sept. 23, 1996, Pub. L. 104–201, title XVIII, § 1804, 110 Stat. 2761. The words “each State in which it is incorporated” are substituted for “the State of Delaware” for consistency in the revised title.
